summary: Production Firestore rules differ from the repository and permit cross-user profile reads and self role changes. Reproduced with the retrieved deployed source in emulators; no production attack writes performed.

findings.issue: Any authenticated user can read another users document under the deployed rules.
findings.recommendation: Review and deploy the intended private-profile rules, then retest positive owner access and cross-user denial.

findings.issue: The deployed owner-write rule accepts a patient changing role to doctor.
findings.recommendation: Use trusted role provisioning and immutable role/email client updates; verify deployed rule hash and emulator cases after release.

findings.issue: Existing Storage test expects a removed client notes uploader and fails against intentional deny-all repository Storage rules.
findings.recommendation: Update the test to assert disabled attachment behavior without relaxing Storage.
